g.text: # Step 1: Break the problem into smaller subproblems
# Step 2: Solve each subproblem (recursively if needed)
# Step 3: Combine all sub-results into a final solution
* Definition for a binary tree node.
* TreeNode(int val, TreeNode left, TreeNode right) {
public boolean isValidBSTHelper(TreeNode node, long min, long max) {
return isValidBSTHelper(node.left, min, node.val) && isValidBSTHelper(node.right, node.val, max);
